name: Dolibarr
description: Dolibarr is a modern software package to manage your organization's activity (contacts, quotes, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, hr, expense reports, accountancy, ecm, manufacturing, ...).
composeYaml:
services:
  dolibarr:
    image: 'dolibarr/dolibarr:latest'
    environment:
      - 'WWW_USER_ID=${WWW_USER_ID:-1000}'
      - 'WWW_GROUP_ID=${WWW_GROUP_ID:-1000}'
      - DOLI_DB_HOST=mariadb
      - 'DOLI_DB_NAME=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-dolibarr-db}'
      - 'DOLI_DB_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'DOLI_DB_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'DOLI_URL_ROOT=${APP_URL}'
      - 'DOLI_ADMIN_LOGIN=${DOLIBARR_USER}'
      - 'DOLI_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${DOLIBARR_PASSWORD}'
      - 'DOLI_CRON=${DOLI_CRON:-0}'
      - 'DOLI_INIT_DEMO=${DOLI_INIT_DEMO:-0}'
      - 'DOLI_COMPANY_NAME=${DOLI_COMPANY_NAME:-MyBigCompany}'
    volumes:
      - 'dolibarr_docs:/var/www/documents'
      - 'dolibarr_custom:/var/www/html/custom'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:80'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  mariadb:
    image: 'mariadb:latest'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-dolibarr-db}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'dolibarr_mariadb_data:/var/lib/mysql'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - healthcheck.sh
        - '--connect'
        - '--innodb_initialized'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Modern CRM software package to manage your company or foundation activity (contacts, suppliers, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, accounting, ...).
